import sys,random
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path.cwd()/'.local/deepeye-implementation-c/competition/deepeye/tests/ai/data_model'))
import test_causal_input as t
rng=random.Random(20261015)
for case in range(500):
    flags=[rng.randrange(65536) for _ in range(rng.randrange(1,25))]
    rows=[t.record(i,100,quality_flags=f) for i,f in enumerate(flags)]
    valid=15;bad=0
    for f in flags: valid &= f&15;bad |= f&0x1ff0
    expected=tuple(float(bool(valid&(1<<c)) and not bool(bad&((1<<(4+c))|(1<<(8+c))|4096))) for c in range(4))
    result=t.build(rows)
    assert result.columns[-1].valid_mask==expected
    before=result.features;rng.shuffle(rows)
    assert t.build(rows).features==before
single=t.build([t.record(1,100)])
assert t.build([t.record(i,100,quality_flags=15|((i%8)<<13)) for i in range(32)]).features==single.features
old=[t.record(i,i) for i in range(31)]
assert t.build(old+[t.record(i+31,100) for i in range(32)]).features==t.build(old+[t.record(31,100)]).features
assert t.build([t.record(1,100),t.record(2,1001)]).features==single.features
assert all(c.source_native_tick_ms is None for c in single.columns)
print('500 independent packed-bit/permutation checks; duplicate/history/future/native-age regressions passed')
